correspondences.notes: No BIDS 1.11.2 suffix for tract profiles or tract statistics tables.

brainlife.desc: CSV of per-tract measures: along-tract profiles (structureID, nodeID, FA, MD...) or tract macrostructure (streamline count, volume, length).
brainlife.name: neuro/tractmeasures

original.desc: A csv file listing various measures and statistics of classified tracts

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Tract-profile and macrostructure analyses, including compiling a project-wide table. Comparing tracts across subjects after node trimming or averaging.

**Not for:** Mixing profile and macro tables without checking columns (datatype tags tell them apart). Comparing profiles made with different tract definitions or node counts.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 7 Apps, output of 23 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.tractmeasures.json

identifying_risks: Rows keyed by subject and session codes
Values from rare conditions in small samples can single people out
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level derived measures without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Use coded subject IDs and drop dates
Release group summaries when per-participant rows are not needed
tier_conditions: Tier 1 once reduced to group statistics with no participant rows
Tier 4 if used as features for predicting cognitive or clinical states
